task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones are in stock, look up the bedroom light and any coupons available for my account, then figure out the best discount for buying one pair. After that, place the order on my credit card, send me an in-app purchase confirmation document, then also generate a PayPal invoice for the same headphones and email it to alice@company.com. Finally, check the bedroom light’s status, restart it, get the current New York time, and send Alice a high-priority app alert saying the device is restarting and to wait 30 seconds before reconnecting.

user_input.query: For user_01, please check if the black Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones are in stock in the audio category. I want 1 unit of product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, and my items are [{product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1}]. Also look up the bedroom light in the bedroom area using device_id light_bedroom and the device type query light, and check any coupons on my account, including coupon_code SAVE15, to find the best discount for buying 1 pair. Then place the order on my credit_card, send me an in-app purchase confirmation document, and also create a paypal invoice for the same headphones and email it to alice@company.com for alice. After that, check the status of the bedroom light, restart it, get the current time in America/New_York, and send alice a high-priority app alert that the device is restarting and to wait 30 seconds before reconnecting.
